blocks.text: Use a queue when items must be processed in arrival order, First-In, First-Out: in BFS of graphs or trees, in task scheduling such as print jobs or web-server requests, and in simulations such as a line of customers in a store.

blocks.prompt: A web server receives requests from many users. Which structure keeps them fair, and why?
blocks.explanation: A queue, because requests are served in the order they arrive.

items: Queue: arrival-order (FIFO) work: BFS, scheduling, simulations of lines.
